entities.summary: Pavlos Sidiropoulos (b. 1948-07-27, Athens) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Athens and Greece. Known in the fields of greece, composers & musicians, europe.
